title: Enforcement.
bodyText: The administrator may maintain an action in this or another state to enforce this part. The court may award reasonable attorney's fees to the prevailing party.
bodyHtml: [§523A-22]  Enforcement.  The administrator may maintain an action in this or another state to enforce this part.  The court may award reasonable attorney's fees to the prevailing party. [L 2008, c 55, pt of §1]
